cards.design_implication: Designs involving multi-component fluid mixing must account for a Ledoux criterion implementation that accommodates non-negligible abundances of many nuclei.
does_not_establish: Accuracy of the mixing model compared to observations
cards.evidence_excerpt: This also motivates a numerical recasting of the Ledoux criterion that is more easily implemented when many nuclei are present at non-negligible abundances. This impacts the way in which MESA star calculates semi-convective and thermohaline mixing.
limitations: The text describes the logical impact on calculation methods but does not provide the specific mathematical formulation or numerical stability analysis of the recasting.
cards.statement: A numerical recasting of the Ledoux criterion impacts how semi-convective and thermohaline mixing are calculated in MESA star.

cards.design_implication: If rotating-star modeling is required, the simulation framework must include mechanisms for diffusing both angular momentum and chemical abundances.
does_not_establish: Quantitative results of the comparison with earlier work
Eligibility rules for star masses or compositions
cards.evidence_excerpt: We implement diffusion of angular momentum and chemical abundances that enable calculations of rotating-star models, which we compare thoroughly with earlier work.
limitations: The excerpt notes the capability exists and was compared to earlier work, but does not specify the boundary conditions or specific results of that comparison.
cards.statement: Implementation of diffusion for angular momentum and chemical abundances enables calculations of rotating-star models.

cards.design_implication: For simulations of massive stars intended to reach core collapse, the envelope physics model must specifically address radiation-dominated conditions to prevent numerical termination.
does_not_establish: Bias controls in the evolution simulation
cards.evidence_excerpt: We introduce a new treatment of radiation-dominated envelopes that allows the uninterrupted evolution of massive stars to core collapse.
limitations: Describes the functional outcome (uninterrupted evolution) but does not detail the physical assumptions or numerical techniques constituting the 'new treatment'.
cards.statement: A new treatment of radiation-dominated envelopes allows the uninterrupted evolution of massive stars to core collapse.
